description: Source code for generating callback interface templates in a web engine project, including type handling, context creation, and include management.

classes.name: IdlTypeBase
classes.description: Base class for IDL types with a property for C++ callback type.

methods.name: cpp_type
methods.description: Determines the C++ type for a given IDL type, handling special cases like String and void, and passing containers by const reference.

methods.name: callback_interface_context
methods.description: Generates context information for a callback interface, including class names and method contexts.

methods.name: add_includes_for_operation
methods.description: Adds necessary include directives for an operation's IDL type and arguments.

methods.name: method_context
methods.description: Creates context data for a callback method, including return type, attributes, and arguments.

methods.name: arguments_context
methods.description: Generates argument declarations and context for callback method arguments.
